mechanism: Both agents can cause immunosuppression and potential additive effects on immune function; vedolizumab's gut-selective integrin antagonism combined with chloroquine's broad immunomodulatory effects may increase infection risk and reduce efficacy of concurrent immunotherapies.
action: Monitor for increased infections and clinical efficacy loss; consider chloroquine alternatives if possible; ensure appropriate infection prophylaxis and baseline/periodic immune monitoring if co-administration is necessary.
